checks.name: four task commits on some branch
Count, clamp, Has and Subtotal committed on some branch
checks.run: for b in $(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/heads); do git grep -q 'func Subtotal' $b -- cart.go && git grep -q 'percent > 100' $b -- coupon.go && git grep -q 'func (c Catalog) Has' $b -- catalog.go && git grep -q 'func Count' $b -- cart.go && exit 0; done; exit 1
